add_litellm_success_callback: add a success callback to litellm that auto-routes async callbacks to the async list
add_litellm_failure_callback: add a failure callback to litellm that auto-routes async callbacks to the async list
add_litellm_input_callback: add an input callback to litellm that auto-routes async callbacks to the async input list
get_callbacks_by_type: get all active callbacks categorized by their type as success, failure, or success_and_failure
get_custom_loggers_for_type: get all custom loggers that are instances of a given class type from all callback lists
